FILE_TO_BOOK = {
    ''61'': ''Matthew'', ''62'': ''Mark'', ''63'': ''Luke'', ''64'': ''John'',
    ''65'': ''Acts'', ''66'': ''Romans'', ''67'': ''1Corinthians'', ''68'': ''2Corinthians'',
    ''69'': ''Galatians'', ''70'': ''Ephesians'', ''71'': ''Philippians'', ''72'': ''Colossians'',
    ''73'': ''1Thessalonians'', ''74'': ''2Thessalonians'', ''75'': ''1Timothy'',
    ''76'': ''2Timothy'', ''77'': ''Titus'', ''78'': ''Philemon'', ''79'': ''Hebrews'',
    ''80'': ''James'', ''81'': ''1Peter'', ''82'': ''2Peter'', ''83'': ''1John'',
    ''84'': ''2John'', ''85'': ''3John'', ''86'': ''Jude'', ''87'': ''Revelation''
}

def parse_morphgnt_file\(filepath\):
    verses = []
    current_verse = None
    current_ref = None
    file_book_code = filepath.stem.split\(''-''\)[0]
    book_name = FILE_TO_BOOK.get\(file_book_code, f''Book{file_book_code}''\)
    
    with open\(filepath, ''r'', encoding=''utf-8''\) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip\(\)
            if not line:
                continue
            parts = line.split\(\)
            if len\(parts\) < 4:
                continue
            
            # Referência: CCVVWW \(6 dígitos\)
            # CC = capítulo, VV = versículo, WW = palavra
            ref = parts[0]
            chapter = int\(ref[0:2]\)
            verse_num = int\(ref[2:4]\)
            # word_num = int\(ref[4:6]\)  # Não precisamos
            
            greek_word = parts[3]
            
            # Chave única: livro + cap + vers
            verse_key = f''{book_name}:{chapter}:{verse_num}''
            
            if verse_key != current_ref:
                if current_verse is not None:
                    current_verse[''text''] = current_verse[''text''].strip\(\)
                    verses.append\(current_verse\)
                current_ref = verse_key
                current_verse = {
                    ''book'': book_name,
                    ''chapter'': chapter,
                    ''verse'': verse_num,
                    ''text'': '''',
                    ''words'': [],
                    ''language'': ''greek''
                }
            current_verse[''words''].append\(greek_word\)
            current_verse[''text''] += greek_word + '' ''
    
    if current_verse is not None:
        current_verse[''text''] = current_verse[''text''].strip\(\)
        verses.append\(current_verse\)
    return verses
